calibration: Seeded fixed rolling pairs: two small balls every two turns and two incompatible team balls every six turns. Every sixth turn includes both kinds. Report actual fixed-AI proxy rollouts and the separate contact-capacity upper bound; never infer a human treatment effect.
controller_policy: AI-led small/team simultaneous overlap preference; initial joint reachability; freeze the selected near-term AI route through its target arrival even if the human leaves the assigned contact. No unseen future balls.
